exponential_sum.closure_argument: Shifting n by 119 fixes n mod 7 and mod 17 and adds 9/10 to the phase modulo one. Each orbit of ten steps multiplies by successive powers of a nontrivial tenth root of unity and sums to zero. Thus each block of 1190 consecutive terms sums to zero exactly.
exponential_sum.scope: Only the October 7, 2017 polynomial and n=3..12002; exact modular reduction before floating trigonometry. No general date rule or winding-number claim.
